extraction.name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
extraction.description: A large multilingual corpus suitable for speech research, derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox, covering 8 languages including about 44.5K hours of English and a total of about 6K hours for other languages.
extraction.creator: Vineel Pratap, Qiantong Xu, Anuroop Sriram, Gabriel Synnaeve, Ronan Collobert
extraction.inLanguage: Multilingual (8 languages: English, German, Dutch, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian, Polish)
extraction.citeAs: MLS: A Large-Scale Multilingual Dataset for Speech Research
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is derived from read audiobooks from LibriVox and consists of 8 languages, including about 44.5K hours of English and a total of about 6K hours for other languages.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Web Scraping, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Some text sources for audiobooks were invalid or redirected to an incorrect page, requiring manual approaches to cover the audiobook text sources.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: LibriVox audiobook data, Project Gutenberg text data
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: Pseudo-labels were generated for segmented audio samples using beam-search decoding with a 4-gram language model on acoustic models used for audio segmentation.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Audio files were downsampled from 48kHz to 16kHz, segmented into 10-20 second segments using trained acoustic models.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Text normalization was performed, including NFKC normalization, removal of unwanted characters, and filtering of characters outside the language's orthography.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Pseudo-labels were generated for audio segments, then matched with source text from audiobooks using term-frequency inverse document-frequency (TF-IDF) similarity score and Smith-Waterman alignment.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Human evaluation of transcripts in development and test sets was performed to correct clear and obvious errors.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Acoustic models using Time-Depth Separable (TDS) Convolutions with Auto-Segmentation Criterion (ASG) loss, wav2letter@anywhere framework
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will be made freely available for anyone, with versioning information and updating timeframe not specified.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset will open new avenues in ASR and Text-To-Speech (TTS) research.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Some biases may be present due to the data collection process, e.g., pseudo-labels may not always have the correct transcription of audio.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Known limitations include data generalization limits and quality issues, e.g., some text sources were invalid or redirected to an incorrect page.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning for ASR and TTS research
